summary: Short kerb by a junction, houses 14 m away on both sides.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign at the end

best_section.where: Twelfth Avenue west kerb, just south of the main road junction

drivers.seclusion: Homes at 14-17 m on the west side, apartments and houses across the road; cars park here but residents are close.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park along the west kerb, so room exists, but the section is short.
drivers.traffic: Beside a busy cross road at the junction; street itself is quiet.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but a No Stopping Any Time sign sits at the south end.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 6.7 m off the line
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the east side and part of the west verge.
cannot_judge: Where the No Stopping zone starts and ends
